transcript:
Meeting header
Date/Time: 2026-08-11 09:00 PT / 16:00 UTC
Duration: 00:58:12
Attendees: Maya T., Diego A., Priya N., Elena S., Aaron K., Monique B., Jared L., Samir P.

Auto Summary: quick handoff meeting to finalize runbook updates and agree finance tagging remediation steps. some discussion on KMS rotation and audit retention windows.

00:00 Maya: ok hey everyone thanks for joining, we're gonna run through the on-call playbook handoff and the finance tag cleanup, I think we have about an hour, please call out if you need extra time
00:12 Diego: yeah sounds good, I'll start with the runbook update what changed, basically we added the new incident triage flow and the pager duty escalation matrix
00:27 Priya: one quick note on the escalation matrix, we need to make sure SSO is referenced; some of the step names were showing as azure ad in the doc and might confuse folks
00:45 Maya: good call, I'll normalize to SSO/SAML in the doc and spell out the group names
01:03 Elena: on the billing side I've got a script to scan for missing cost-center tags but I want to run it against a subset first, don't want to clobber production billing allocations
01:18 Aaron: agreed, we need a staging run and an owners list before any tagging changes, finance can't reassign charges after the month closes
01:32 Monique: procurement will need an approval flow if we change any existing purchase orders or reclassify storage buckets, legal sign-off likely
01:48 Jared: legal fine with remediation but we need an audit trail, please keep the change set and link to the ticketing system
02:05 Diego: on the runbook, the KV cache step was mis-typed as K-V cash in one section — whoops — I think thats from the auto transcript, I'll fix that
02:22 Priya: ha yes KV cache not K-V cash, classic; also KMS key rotation window, we talked about rotating monthly vs quarterly, what's the consensus
02:38 Maya: given compliance burden and consensus from security, quarterly rotation with emergency rotation if compromise suspected, that's our recommendation
02:54 Elena: can we schedule an overlapping maintenance window for rotation so billing does not reconcile mid-cycle? e.g., take a 2-hour window on Sundays
03:09 Aaron: that works, but finance wants the rotation logs to be in CloudTrail for retention 2 years and export to secure S3 for backups
03:25 Priya: we'll add the export step to the runbook and set retention policy to 2 years; note: retention for audit might be extended for certain customers
03:40 Diego: question on alerting thresholds — the runbook mentions token error rate and latency spikes; do we want the same thresholds for dedicated infra versus hosted
03:56 Maya: good point — we should parametrize thresholds by deployment class, I'll add a table: hosted/dedicated/private and the default thresholds
04:12 Elena: billing tags: we found 312 orphaned resources last month, many in eu-west-1, looks like previous automation didn't run due to IAM changes
04:29 Aaron: those will need owners assigned; can we add owner as a required tag in the provisioning templates going forward
04:44 Monique: procurement can enforce owner tagging at approval time, we can add a gate in the marketplace request flow
04:59 Jared: legal wants a record of the gating rule changes; also curious about whether this intersects with our SOC 2 artifacts
05:15 Priya: yes SOC 2 will look at resource change control and who made the changes, so runbook needs to include the access review cadence
05:31 Diego: I'm going to propose a monthly access review and a quarterly deeper review for privileged roles
05:46 Maya: excellent. next, dry-run of incident — Diego you want to lead a tabletop for on-call ops next week?
06:00 Diego: sure, I'll propose times, probably 60-90 minute session and include a finance-side sim for billing impact
06:15 Elena: please make sure the billing sim does not run actual scripts, just a dry stage exercise with sample CSVs
06:30 Aaron: finance will provide a set of sample invoices and a test Cost Center mapping for the sim
06:46 Monique: procurement will join the tabletop to see the gating flow in action
07:00 Jared: I'll review the KMS rotation text and give a legal note in the doc
07:15 Priya: couple more small items: update the PagerDuty runbook link, add RBAC matrix for runbook editors, and document the audit log export location
07:32 Maya: ok noted. any blockers to timelines? Elena you said you could run the script in staging by the 20th?
07:42 Elena: yes target Aug 20th for staging run, if no issues we can run it in production the following pay cycle but will coordinate with finance
07:55 Aaron: finance prefers to do production tag changes in the first 5 days of the month to avoid mid-month splits
08:10 Maya: we'll follow that. quick recap: Maya updates runbook, Elena billing script, Priya KMS plan, Diego tabletop scheduling, Aaron confirms owners, Monique procurement gate changes, Jared legal note.
08:30 Diego: transcript note — audio had a little echo at the start so some words were mangled, expect typos in the auto sections
08:45 Maya: thanks all, I'll push a Confluence draft and ping the #oncall channel. meeting adjourned.

- Maya: update runbook and param table (due 2026-08-16)
